Title: NETMESSAGE:A Shadow moves in the dark. We cannot get out.
Translation: 阴影在黑暗中移动。我们出不去了。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Drums, drums in the deep. We cannot get out.
Translation: 鼓声，深渊中的鼓声。我们出不去了。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Here lies Balin, son of Fundin, Lord of Moria
Translation: 此处安葬着巴林，芬丁之子，摩瑞亚之主。

Title: NETMESSAGE:A Balrog. A demon of the ancient world. This foe is beyond any of you. Run!
Translation: 一个炎魔。一个远古世界的恶魔。这个敌人超乎你们所有人。快跑！
